## Vireo v0.14.1

A polish release for the new macOS app: a clean launch with a proper macOS icon, a terminal that fits in on the Mac, and a `vx` fix that stops a stale anchor from ever editing the wrong line.

### Highlights

- **Clean macOS launch.** Vireo now opens straight to its own icon. Before, the Dock showed a placeholder icon, then waited about two seconds before swapping in the real one. Apps launched from Finder or the Dock still pick up your shell's `PATH`, so Homebrew tools and CLI agents are found as before (`21f2e6a`).
- **New macOS app icon.** A dark rounded tile with a soft teal glow, so the V logo stands out in light and dark Docks instead of sitting on a plain white tile (`21f2e6a`).
- **A terminal that fits in on the Mac.** New tabs are named after your real shell (`zsh`, `bash`) instead of always "PowerShell". Text is 12px on macOS to match the rest of the UI (Windows stays at 14px). Prompt icons from powerlevel10k, Starship and oh-my-posh now render when a Nerd Font is installed, instead of showing as boxes (`4043bcb`).

### Fixes

- **vx: stale anchors no longer edit the wrong line.** Each `vx` CLI command ran with no memory of edits made by earlier commands. An anchor printed before an edit could then land on a different line that happened to share its hash (a closing brace or a blank line) without any warning. The CLI now keeps its edit journal in the user cache folder between runs, so old anchors follow their lines. When it can't be sure, it still asks instead of guessing. Set `VX_NO_JOURNAL=1` to turn this off, or `VX_JOURNAL_DIR` to store it elsewhere. The `vx mcp` server was not affected (`9d93f78`).
- **Tauri production mode.** Release builds no longer run in Tauri's development mode, which on macOS replaced the Dock icon after launch (`21f2e6a`).

### Installing on macOS

The macOS build is not notarized, so the first launch of a downloaded copy needs one extra step: open Vireo once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. You can also run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Vireo.app` in Terminal.
